title: Municipal-Scale Natural-Capital Accounting for Local Governance in Albania
author: Dr. Kledian Kodra

steps.title: Institutional Setup
steps.instruction: Establish the administrative framework for Natural Capital Accounting (NCA) over a period of 1–2 weeks.

substeps.instruction: Appoint a Working Group consisting of representatives from environment, agriculture, forestry, water, tourism, and finance.
Sign an internal data-sharing order.
Identify the NCA focal point.

steps.title: Create Asset Register
steps.instruction: Identify and map all biotic and abiotic natural assets over 3–4 weeks.

substeps.instruction: Collect spatial layers for land cover, hydrology, forests, and soils.
Populate the asset inventory including mineral resources, energy resources, water resources, land resources, and biodiversity (including 6 protected areas).
Classify assets using SEEA-EA ecosystem-types and manual typologies.
Produce asset maps and tables.

steps.title: Quantify Physical Ecosystem-Service Flows
steps.instruction: Perform annual quantification of provisioning, regulating, and cultural services over 4–6 weeks.

substeps.instruction: Calculate agricultural yields.
Estimate forest biomass.
Model water regulation using hydrology modelling.
Calculate soil erosion using RUSLE.
Determine oil and mineral extraction volumes.
Measure tourism visitation using recreation metrics.
Compile annual physical flow tables.

steps.title: Perform Monetary Valuation
steps.instruction: Convert physical flows into Albanian Lek (ALL/year) over 3–5 weeks.

substeps.instruction: Apply market-price valuation for agriculture, tourism, and timber.
Apply resource-rent valuation for oil, minerals, and hydropower.
Apply replacement cost method for water purification and erosion control.
Apply benefit transfer method for biodiversity.
Convert all physical flows to ALL/year.
Compute asset values using the present-value formula.

steps.title: Integrate into Governance
steps.instruction: Incorporate NCA results into local governance and planning over 4–8 weeks.

substeps.instruction: Present results to the Working Group.
Integrate findings into the Medium-Term Budgetary Framework (MTBP) and local plans.
Prepare a council briefing.
Upload data to the national system (MoI–ASLSG).
